parameters.command: MNT="/mnt/isoloted-db-backup"; BACKUP_DIR="$MNT/Isolated_DBbackup/itshare/Telecom-DB-Backup/aclsys/chennai_db"; echo "CHECK_TIME=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')"; echo "HOST=$(hostname)"; echo "USER=$(whoami)"; echo "BACKUP_DIR=$BACKUP_DIR"; echo "=== MOUNT CHECK ==="; if [ ! -d "$MNT" ]; then echo "MOUNT_STATUS=FAILED"; echo "BACKUP_DIR_STATUS=FAILED"; echo "ERROR=Mount directory $MNT does not exist"; exit 2; fi; if ! mountpoint -q "$MNT"; then echo "MOUNT_STATUS=FAILED"; echo "BACKUP_DIR_STATUS=FAILED"; echo "ERROR=$MNT is not mounted"; exit 2; fi; echo "MOUNT_STATUS=OK"; echo "--- MOUNT DETAILS ---"; df -hP "$MNT" | tail -n 1; echo "=== DIRECTORY CHECK ==="; if [ ! -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ]; then echo "BACKUP_DIR_STATUS=FAILED"; echo "ERROR=Backup directory does not exist"; echo "--- TOP LEVEL OF MOUNT ---"; ls -la "$MNT"; exit 3; fi; echo "BACKUP_DIR_STATUS=OK"; echo "BACKUP_FILES_BEGIN"; find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.sql.zip' -o -name '*.sql.gz' \) -printf '%f\n' | LC_ALL=C sort; echo "BACKUP_FILES_END"; echo "CHECK_STATUS=SUCCESS"; exit 0
